facts.fact: A child enrolled before age 5 must be re-enrolled with all biometrics when the child turns 5 (same Aadhaar number kept)
facts.quote: The child should be re-enroled when the child attains an age of 5 years and all biometric data should be provided.

facts.fact: All biometrics must be updated again on reaching age 15
facts.quote: Age between 5 and 15 years at the time of enrolment - The Aadhaar number holder should furnish all biometrics for updates when he/she attains age of 15 years.

facts.fact: The first biometric update between ages 5 and 7 is free (fee sheet)
facts.quote: If done first time between the age of 5 to 7 years: Free#
facts.note: The Aadhaar Seva Kendra page (uidai.gov.in/en/aadhaar-seva-kendra) gives the same: '(i) If done first time between the age of 5 to 7 years: Free#'.

summary: UIDAI 'Updating data on Aadhaar' still says re-enrol all biometrics at 5 and update at 15; fee sheet keeps the first update between 5 and 7 free.
